payload.recallText: The mail came and I picked up two envelopes. I told my sister Clara I had news about my baseball career. Clara asks if there is trouble. I say no but almost just as bad. I go into the house and run into my momsey with a jug of water. the jug cracks and mom says it will ruin her carpet. I told her I was just practicing with my pitching arm. I tell my mom I am going to be drafted from the central league to st louis. my mom is thrilled and says she is proud of me. my sister Clara gets so excited for me when she hears the news. I then tell my mom I have no say in what team I end up with. She says I am good at baseball but she wouldn't have chose this career for me. I then open the other letter and Clara asks me what it says. I told her it was Mabel and her brother Reggie and that they were coming for a visit. Clara says she has never met them. I tell Clara she might meet them today. I ask Clara if she wants to come to the train station with me and she says no not in this weather. There is a blizzard outside and when I get to the train station I get bad news. the trains have been stopped because of the bad weather. I wait for a few hours and then I get even worse news. the train is stuck and I wonder how I can help my friends.
